name: informatica-assessment
description: Assess an Informatica PowerCenter estate before converting it: check an XML export for completeness with toolkit analyzer scan, import it with collect etl, build table-level lineage with ds lineage, then decompose the estate into dependency-ordered, scored migration waves with migration plan — a plan of record with an inventory, cutover constraints, and dead, audit, and interface objects called out. Runs entirely offline against a stub datasource if the legacy database is unavailable, and needs no LLM and no agent license.
